nodes.name: formatter.go

nodes.name: FormatContextForAI
nodes.summary: Entry point rendering the full kernel.Context as AI-readable text in Chinese or English.

nodes.name: formatContextData

nodes.summary: Formats current open positions in Chinese.

nodes.name: formatCurrentPositionsEN
nodes.summary: Formats current open positions in English.

nodes.name: formatCandidateCoinsEN

nodes.name: formatKlineDataEN

nodes.name: getOIInterpretationEN
nodes.summary: Maps OI-vs-price direction combinations to an English interpretation label.

nodes.name: grid_engine.go
nodes.summary: Grid trading engine: builds bilingual grid system/user prompts describing level states and action rules, queries the AI for per-level grid actions, parses and whitelists grid decision JSON, and constructs GridContext from market data.

nodes.name: GridLevelInfo
nodes.summary: State of one grid level: price, side, order/position state, allocation, and unrealized PnL.

nodes.name: GridContext
nodes.summary: Full grid state snapshot handed to the AI: price range, spacing, levels, active orders, investment, and leverage.

nodes.name: BuildGridSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Selects the Chinese or English grid system prompt.

nodes.name: buildGridSystemPromptZh
nodes.summary: Chinese grid-strategy system prompt with level semantics and action rules.

nodes.name: buildGridSystemPromptEn
nodes.summary: English grid-strategy system prompt with level semantics and action rules.

nodes.name: BuildGridUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Selects the Chinese or English grid user prompt.

nodes.name: buildGridUserPromptZh
nodes.summary: Chinese grid state prompt: price range, level table, active orders, and PnL.

nodes.name: buildGridUserPromptEn
nodes.summary: English grid state prompt: price range, level table, active orders, and PnL.

nodes.name: GetGridDecisions
nodes.summary: Queries the AI for per-level grid actions and returns them wrapped in a FullDecision.

nodes.name: parseGridDecisions
nodes.summary: Parses the AI's JSON array of per-level grid actions into Decisions.

nodes.name: extractJSONArray
nodes.summary: Extracts the first JSON array from AI response text.

nodes.name: isValidGridAction
nodes.summary: Whitelists allowed grid action strings.

nodes.name: BuildGridContextFromMarketData
nodes.summary: Constructs a GridContext (bounds, spacing, levels) from market data and the grid strategy config.

nodes.name: prompt_builder.go
nodes.summary: Legacy language-aware PromptBuilder producing Chinese/English system prompts with decision requirements, decision example formatting, and decision-format validation.

nodes.name: PromptBuilder
nodes.summary: Language-aware builder for the legacy crypto prompt set.

nodes.name: NewPromptBuilder
nodes.summary: Constructs a PromptBuilder for the given language.

nodes.name: BuildSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Returns the Chinese or English legacy system prompt.

nodes.name: BuildUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Formats context via FormatContextForAI and appends the decision instruction.

nodes.name: buildSystemPromptZH
nodes.summary: Chinese legacy system prompt with trading rules and decision requirements.

nodes.name: getDecisionRequirementsZH
nodes.summary: Chinese decision-format requirements block.

nodes.name: buildSystemPromptEN
nodes.summary: English legacy system prompt with trading rules and decision requirements.

nodes.name: getDecisionRequirementsEN
nodes.summary: English decision-format requirements block.

nodes.name: FormatDecisionExample
nodes.summary: Returns a language-appropriate example decision JSON block.

nodes.name: ValidateDecisionFormat
nodes.summary: Validates parsed decisions for required fields and action-specific constraints.

nodes.name: engine_analysis.go
nodes.summary: The AI decision pipeline: gates on CME session and feed health, fetches multi-timeframe market data, builds system/user prompts, calls the AI via the MCP client, parses and repairs the JSON decision envelope, validates decisions, and exposes the force-flat signaling hook.

nodes.name: GetFullDecision
nodes.summary: Back-compat wrapper delegating to GetFullDecisionWithStrategy with the default engine and variant.

nodes.name: GetFullDecisionWithStrategy
nodes.summary: Heart of a decision cycle: session/feed-health gating, market data fetch, prompt assembly, AI call, envelope parsing, and validation.

nodes.name: fetchMarketDataWithStrategy
nodes.summary: Fetches multi-timeframe market data for open positions and candidate coins per the strategy's timeframe and indicator-period settings.

nodes.name: parseFullDecisionResponse
nodes.summary: Parses the AI response into decisions, then applies the leverage/sizing/risk validation gate.

nodes.name: extractCoTTrace
nodes.summary: Extracts the chain-of-thought reasoning block from the AI response.

nodes.name: extractDecisions
nodes.summary: Extracts and repairs the JSON decision array from AI response text.

nodes.name: fixMissingQuotes
nodes.summary: Repairs unquoted string values in near-JSON AI output.

nodes.name: validateJSONFormat
nodes.summary: Pre-validates extracted JSON structure before unmarshalling.

nodes.name: ForceFlatSignaler
nodes.summary: Interface for brokers that can flatten all positions for a trader — the kernel-side hook behind the risk force-flat endpoint.

nodes.name: MaybeForceFlat
nodes.summary: Invokes the broker force-flat path through the ForceFlatSignaler hook, logging a no-op warning when unwired.

nodes.name: engine_prompt_futures.go
nodes.summary: Futures-specific prompt builders for CME contracts (MNQ/NQ/ES...): the decision system prompt with contract specs, tick math and risk-mode blocks, plus a compact indicator-based user prompt used by both the live loop and the nq_smoke harness.
nodes.languageNotes: Prompt output is locked by golden tests — the balanced mode must stay byte-identical to the default.

nodes.name: BuildFuturesDecisionSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Public entry for the futures decision system prompt (balanced mode).

nodes.name: futuresVariantMode
nodes.summary: Maps prompt_variant strings (futures, futures-aggressive, futures-conservative...) to the futures mode selection.

nodes.name: buildFuturesPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the futures system prompt: contract specs, tick math, risk-mode block, and the strict reasoning/decision envelope contract.

nodes.name: futuresInstrument
nodes.summary: Static contract descriptor (description, point value, tick size, treasury flag) for known CME roots.

nodes.name: describeFutures
nodes.summary: Resolves contract description, point value, and tick size for a CME root symbol.

nodes.name: FuturesPromptConfig
nodes.summary: Contract parameters (multiplier, tick size, stop bounds, min risk-reward) driving the standalone futures prompt.

nodes.name: FuturesContext
nodes.summary: Snapshot of futures indicators (price, EMA20/50, RSI14, MACD, ATR14, Bollinger) for the user prompt.

nodes.name: BuildFuturesSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the standalone futures system prompt from an explicit FuturesPromptConfig (used by nq_smoke).

nodes.name: BuildFuturesUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Renders the compact futures user prompt: price vs EMAs, RSI bucket, MACD, ATR, and Bollinger position.

nodes.name: schema.go
nodes.summary: Bilingual decision-schema definitions: field and rule metadata with ZH/EN names, formulas and rationale, the OI interpretation matrix, common AI mistakes, and the schema prompt block injected into system prompts.

nodes.name: BilingualFieldDef
nodes.summary: Field metadata with Chinese/English names, unit, formulas, and descriptions plus language-resolving getters.

nodes.name: BilingualRuleDef
nodes.summary: Trading-rule metadata with bilingual descriptions and rationale.

nodes.name: OIInterpretationType
nodes.summary: The four open-interest-vs-price interpretation combinations used in prompts.

nodes.name: GetSchemaPrompt
nodes.summary: Returns the Chinese or English decision-schema prompt block.

nodes.name: getSchemaPromptZH
nodes.summary: Chinese schema documentation injected into system prompts.

nodes.name: getSchemaPromptEN
nodes.summary: English schema documentation injected into system prompts.

nodes.name: formatFieldDefZH
nodes.summary: Formats one bilingual field definition line in Chinese.

nodes.name: formatFieldDefEN
nodes.summary: Formats one bilingual field definition line in English.

nodes.name: cme_calendar.go
nodes.summary: CME Globex session calendar: open/closed detection with the daily maintenance break, full holiday schedule (including Good Friday via Easter computation), session-day start/keys, and Central Time blackout windows.

nodes.name: IsCMEOpen
nodes.summary: Reports whether CME Globex is open at t, accounting for the Friday close, weekend gap, daily maintenance hour, and holidays.

nodes.name: CMESessionDayStart
nodes.summary: Returns the 5pm CT start of the CME session day containing now.

nodes.name: CMESessionDayKey
nodes.summary: Formats the CME session day as a date key used for daily guardrail resets.

nodes.name: InBlackoutWindow
nodes.summary: Reports whether now falls inside a configured HH:MM-HH:MM Central Time blackout window.

nodes.name: isCMEHoliday
nodes.summary: Full CME holiday table: fixed and floating US holidays plus Good Friday.

nodes.name: easterSunday
nodes.summary: Computes Easter Sunday for a year (anonymous Gregorian algorithm) to derive Good Friday.
